paragraphs.text: Bejahn was the village elder of Sekana .

Bejahn was elected on behalf of Sekana village to call in the imperial champion, Tetsuo Umezawa , when the cat-dragon Wasitora attacked the village, demanding fish. She was hurt by Xira Arien for being at the wrong place at the wrong time, for Arien was sent by Ramses Overdark to hurt Tetsuo's entourage to lure the champion into Overdark's plans with the Edemi Islands , but Bejahn recovered and helped Tetsuo out on several occasions afterward.
Bejahn remained in Sekana and witnessed Orai Daiyeta 's kentsu squad being wiped out by the nekoru and her five kittens.
